usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with JSON body {model, max_tokens, messages:[{role,content}]} (Anthropic Messages format), paid via x402
quirks: max_tokens is required by the Anthropic Messages API or the call will fail
price varies by token usage; the minimal hi/16-token call cost $0.001
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with an Anthropic Messages-format JSON body: {"model":"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6","max_tokens":N,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Payment is handled via x402 (USDC on Base, no API key). The response is a standard Anthropic message object; read the model's reply at body.content[0].text and token usage at body.usage. Cost varies with token count.
